# KM Online Solutions

> KM Online Solutions is a website creator in Manila, Philippines that builds SEO-optimized, mobile-responsive websites for businesses in Metro Manila and across the Philippines. Founded by Kirk and based in Eastwood, Quezon City, the agency has delivered web design projects for spas, restaurants, real estate agents, law firms, solar companies, preschools, and eCommerce brands.

## Services

KM Online Solutions offers 8 core web design and development services:

1. **Business Website Design** - Professionally designed, SEO-optimized, mobile-friendly business websites. Starting at ₱4,999.
2. **Landing Page Design** - High-converting landing pages optimized for maximum leads and sales.
3. **Web Hosting Services** - Reliable high-speed hosting in the Philippines with 99.9% uptime guarantee.
4. **eCommerce Development** - Secure online stores with WooCommerce, shopping cart, payment gateways, and seamless checkout. Starting at ₱19,999.
5. **Website Redesign** - Revamp outdated websites with modern design, better SEO, and improved user experience.
6. **Custom Development** - Tailor-made websites with custom functionality including school management systems, patient records, hotel booking, and real estate management.
7. **Database Management** - Secure and efficient database design, migration, and management for business applications.
8. **AI Automation** - Integrate AI-powered automation into workflows to save time, reduce errors, and scale faster.

## Pricing

All pricing is a one-time fee with no monthly charges.

- **Tier 1 - Basic (₱4,999)**: 1-page website, responsive design, unlimited bandwidth, cross-browser compatibility, social media links, testimonials, chat integration, contact form, 1 business email
- **Tier 2 - Advance (₱10,999)**: Everything in Basic plus up to 5 pages, SEO, product/service listing, Facebook and Instagram integration, up to 3 chat integrations, booking forms, 5 business emails. Most popular plan.
- **Tier 3 - Ecommerce (₱19,999)**: Everything in Advance plus up to 10 pages, WooCommerce, up to 50 products, add-to-cart, shopping cart, customer login, online payment integration, email marketing.
- **Custom Development (Contact for quote)**: Custom functionality including school management, patient records, sales management, event management, restaurant reservations, hotel booking, real estate management, API integrations.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router) with React 19
- **Language**: TypeScript 5
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4
- **Animations**: Framer Motion
- **Email**: Nodemailer (SMTP)
- **Analytics**: Vercel Analytics
- **Deployment**: Vercel
- **Fonts**: Roboto Slab (headings), JetBrains Mono (monospace)
